verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own Snippets feature inserts commonly used phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a keyboard shortcut, and snippets can be shared across a team. That covers the core of not retyping the same reply. However, nothing in the evidence shows variables, placeholders, or attachments inside snippets, which are explicit parts of this story. missing for 10: documented variables/placeholder fields in snippets, documented attachment support in snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply

citations.quote: With Snippets, you can automate typing and push past this limit. Insert commonly-used phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a simple keyboard shortcut.
You can also share Snippets with your team, so your team can move faster, with consistent, up-to-date, and high-performing messaging.
Snippets can now be shared across your team, so you can all work faster with current and consistent messaging.
